In 1987, a rapist terrorizes Scarborough. Police hunt him down, but he vanishes. Soon, a teenage girl’s body surfaces, leading to a shocking discovery: a sadistic newlywed couple.
In 1997, a man and woman abduct and assault women in their minivan. As law enforcement closes in, they realize capturing these fugitives won’t be easy—they live in the van.
A retired couple is stabbed to death, leaving a town in fear of satanic cults. Suspicion falls on their daughter, but the truth reveals a dark, manipulative duo.
Between 1996-1999, women disappear in Truth or Consequences, NM. The escape of a chained woman leads authorities to a couple’s gruesome “Toy Box” of torture.
In 1985, a shoplifting case in South San Francisco leads police to a year-long trail of missing people and a horrifying discovery of a secret sex bunker and videotaped torture.
He was destined for crime, she was spoiled and affluent. Together, they embarked on a shocking crime spree in 1978, becoming one of the most notorious criminal duos of the century.
In 1998, LAPD uncovers a businessman’s murder connected to a con-artist mother and son duo. They set up a massive sting in NYC to stop them before they kill again.
In 1977, Colleen Stan’s hitchhike turns into a seven-year nightmare of abuse with Cameron and Janice Hooker. As time passes, her situation blurs the lines of captivity.
A Michigan man’s shocking tale about his ex-wife’s confession to killing five patients leaves police questioning if they’re dealing with killers or a scorned lover’s revenge.
A look at one of the most shocking and controversial cases in Hawaiian history--the 1991 rape and murder of beautiful 23-year-old Dana Ireland.

In November 1995, close friends Halima Jones and Ruby Joyner went out shopping together in Peachtree City, Georgia, but never came home. An all-out manhunt was launched, and four days later, an abandoned mini-van was found.

Linda Sobek, a pretty, vivacious Los Angeles model turns up missing after a photo shoot. The police investigation leads to photographer Charles Rathbun, who, after much back-and-forth, says he killed her by accident.
A woman who had been married 10 times, sometimes committing bigamy, goes on trial for murdering her last husband.
Jack and Linda Jones, a Florida couple, seemed to have the perfect life--until Jack turned up dead.

Examines a case that has been traveling through the Virginia criminal justice system for 10 years. In 1993, Merry Pease claimed that her husband shot her, but authorities charged that she killed her husband and then shot herself.
Maria feared for her safety as one of her fellow employees at the hospital where she worked became increasingly volatile.
This episode tells the harrowing story of how two students and a professor at Virginia Tech University managed to survive the April 16, 2007 massacre at the school.
